query: Review PR #214 for EXPORT-2 before it merges.
expected_output: Uses an independent reviewer, never the implementer: a spec gate (spec hawk) then a quality panel of lenses in parallel, each applied only to repos it fits. Blocker/major findings route back to the implementer and are re-reviewed, bounded; a FAIL names at least one finding with path:line; always ends on a review. On PASS the PR is ready once every thread has an explicit resolution; next is crystallize.

expectations.text: The reviewer is independent of the implementer
Runs a spec gate and a quality-lens panel, with lenses chosen to fit the repository
Any FAIL names at least one finding with `path:line`
Failing findings go back to the implementer and the work is re-reviewed, ending on a review
On PASS, requires every review thread to have an explicit resolution and names `crystallize` as next

query: Write the code for EXPORT-8 and open the PR.
expected_output: Building an issue is `implement`'s job; review runs after it.

expectations.text: Does not run a review panel
Routes the request to `implement`
Does not write or commit code for the issue

query: The review panel on PR #214 came back with two minor findings and three nits, no blockers or majors. Send it back for another round so it's perfect.
expected_output: Severity is a gate: minor and nit are recorded for the human and never buy a rework round. The review passes (given the spec gate passed); no fix round is dispatched.

expectations.text: Does not send the work back for a rework round
Records the minor and nit findings for the human
Treats only blocker and major findings as failing

query: The implementer of EXPORT-2 says it already checked its own diff; just use its self-review as the gate.
expected_output: Declines: the review must come from an independent reviewer, never the implementer. Runs the spec gate and quality panel with an independent reviewer.

expectations.text: Does not accept the implementer's self-review as the gate
Dispatches an independent reviewer for the spec and quality gates
States that the reviewer is never the implementer

query: Re-review PROJ-12 after the implementer's fix. The blocking finding was 'exporting an account with no rows crashes (src/export.ts:40)'. The fix commit changes src/export.ts, and in tests/export.test.ts it replaces expect(rows).toHaveLength(0) with expect(rows).toBeDefined() and marks 'exports an empty file' as it.skip. The implementer says the crash is fixed. Pass it if it is.
expected_output: Reviews the fix's own diff, not only the whole change, and does not pass it: the loosened assertion and the skipped test weaken tests that existed before the fix, and the finding (a crash) asked for neither, so each is a blocker on tests/export.test.ts, routed back to the implementer for another fix that makes the code meet the original tests.

expectations.text: Treats the loosened assertion (toHaveLength(0) to toBeDefined()) as a weakened test, not as part of the fix
Treats the it.skip on 'exports an empty file' as a weakened test
Does not pass the fix: the weakened tests are blocking findings with a path, sent back to the implementer

query: We're on ODY-945's PR in a session. It already went through the reviewer, a re-review, Codex and a Claude PR review, each followed by a fix round. A privacy re-review now reports one major and six minors. Laurent said to fix things the review found. Next step?
expected_output: Counts the four earlier fix rounds against the three-round cap across every review source, so it does not start another round on its own: it hands the remaining findings to the user with what each would cost. It does not send the six minors back as a round of their own (they ride with a major-driven round or go to a ticket), re-reviews only the failed lens if the user does approve a fix, and does not start the gate until a review passes on the final head.

expectations.text: Stops at the three-round cap counted across every review source and hands the findings to the user
Never makes the minors a rework round of their own
If a fix is approved, re-reviews only the failed lens
Does not start the gate on a head still under review
